evals.prompt: Write a user-guide article for tenant receptionists on how to register a new customer record, handle the duplicate phone warning, and collect the consultation fee before issuing a queue token, plus your handoff note to the Ops and Support Lead.
evals.expected_output: Produces a plain, numbered step-by-step receptionist guide using synthetic customer record examples only, covering customer record registration, the duplicate phone warning, fee-before-token billing (UPI QR / cash), and reminding staff that receptionists cannot open tenantal notes, accompanied by a standard handoff note to Ops and Support Lead with zero em-dashes.
assertions: Covers customer record registration, duplicate warning, and fee-before-token flow using synthetic demo data only
Uses plain, non-jargon numbered steps suitable for a tenant receptionist
Includes a standard handoff note to Ops and Support Lead and contains zero em-dashes (U+2014)
